text:
IncidentBot: [ALERT] Traffic anomaly: rate-gate errors spiking in eu-west canary (alerts: 501, 3xx->429). paging oncall: @Robert Oncall :rotating_light:

Maya SRE: I'm seeing 429 surge from canary nodes 12-14, correlation with the 10:22 deploy of rate-routing v2.

Robert Oncall: on it. grabbing logs and will join bridge. can someone paste the deploy id?

Deploy Bot: deploy started by Avery Eng at 2026-03-15T10:22Z, id: deploy-20260315-1342, rollout: canary 10% -> checking. :white_check_mark:

Avery Eng: yep that was the canary-only rollout. it changed exemption matching for reserved tokens (regex->jsonpath). surprised it's blowing up already.

Maya SRE: sample header from failing requests:
```
{"user_id":"acct-8321","token_type":"reserved","route":"embed.v1","quota_key":"acct-8321:reserved"}
```

Maya SRE: the new matcher seems to drop exemptions when `token_type` === `reserved` and `quota_key` present but differently encoded. result: request gets treated as non-exempt -> rate-gate applied -> 429.

Claire Support: we're seeing multiple support tickets from EU customers about rate-limited requests. top impacted customers: BetaApps Inc, ShortWrites. Not yet escalated to CS leads.

Nav CS: BetaApps reported realtime LLM timeouts; they sent logs showing 429s and partial responses. They've asked for ETA.

Robert Oncall: immediate mitigation plan: 1) enable kill-switch for rate-routing v2 canary 2) rollback canary if kill-switch doesn't drop errors 3) notify customers. flipping kill-switch now.

Jamie Platform: pinging infra to ensure kill-switch signal propagates to serving plane (feature flags go through config plane -> subscribers).

Avery Eng: flip command:
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://flags.internal/api/flip \
  -d '{"flag":"rate_routing_v2_canary","value":false,"actor":"avery"}'
```

Avery Eng: executed. response: `{ "status": "ok", "propagated": false }` — looks like subscribers not fully reconnected.

Maya SRE: killing connection to canary nodes 12-14 at LB layer to force fallback to stable. command on infra:
```
ssh infra-proxy-1
sudo iptables -I FORWARD -s 10.0.12.0/24 -j DROP
```

Deploy Bot: rollback job queued: deploy-20260315-1342 -> rollback to deploy-20260315-1220. ETA ~2m after manual approve.

Robert Oncall: approved rollback. kicking now.

IncidentBot: [INFO] rollback started by Robert Oncall at 2026-03-15T10:28Z. canary -> stable fallback.

Maya SRE: metrics are trending down. 429s in eu-west dropped from 18% -> 2% in 90s. KCPS errors still present for a small subset.

Claire Support: notifying BetaApps and ShortWrites: "we observed a canary rollout that caused transient rate-throttling; we've rolled back and are monitoring. you're unlikely to be impacted further; reach out if you see more 429s." sending now.

Nav CS: BetaApps replied: "thanks, we saw drops around 10:29Z and are recovering. please send postmortem."

Avery Eng: root cause: the new exemption matcher converts nested quota keys to a compact path and fails on certain encoded strings (colon vs percent-encoding). quick repro: when `quota_key` contains `:` the jsonpath matched incorrectly -> rule didn't trigger. failing unit was introduced in PR #8192.

Maya SRE: also observed token-accounting mismatch: some requests were double-counted as non-exempt then exempt later, causing temporary token ledger spikes. ledger reconciler job logged "reconcile:delta=+334 tokens" at 10:27Z.

Jamie Platform: for immediate followups: 1) add a defensive check in the matcher to treat uncertain matches as exempt (fail-open for exemptions) 2) add smoke test that sends colon-encoded quota_keys through matcher 3) improve flag propagation monotonicity so kill-switch is effective fast.

Avery Eng: agreed. I'll open a hotfix PR to revert matcher change and add tests. PR will be small: revert PR #8192 and add integration test. target: ship by EOD.

Robert Oncall: timeline summary for incident channel:
- 10:22Z deploy canary started
- 10:24Z IncidentBot alerted on 429 surge
- 10:25Z oncall paged, initial triage finished
- 10:26Z attempted kill-switch flip (propagation issue)
- 10:28Z manual LB isolation + rollback approved
- 10:29Z rollback completed, errors decreased
- 10:32Z customer notifications sent

Maya SRE: impact estimate: peak affected requests ~3.5% of eu-west traffic for ~7 minutes; dedicated customers with reserved tokens saw ~1-3 minute degraded throughput, some partial responses. No data exfiltration.

Claire Support: updating support tickets with timeline and mitigation steps. tagging legal/compliance? likely not needed.

Nav CS: will schedule customer follow-ups with BetaApps for APM logs if they want deeper analysis.

Deploy Bot: rollback completed: success. new active deploy: deploy-20260315-1220

IncidentBot: [POST-INCIDENT] please create a postmortem doc and link it here. recommended assignees: Avery Eng (engineer), Maya SRE (ops), Claire Support (customer comms).

Avery Eng: creating PR now, will include revert + extra test + a backfill reconciliation job run. Also adding alert to detect "exemption-trend" anomalies earlier.

Jamie Platform: action items — (1) make kill-switch flip idempotent and report propagation status, (2) LB automation for fast evacuation of canaries, (3) add quota_key encoding tests to ingress pipeline.

Robert Oncall: closing active paging. switching to monitoring mode for 2 hours. please update postmortem when ready. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

Maya SRE: noted. leaving channel open for follow-ups.

Claire Support: will follow up with customers once postmortem draft is ready.

Nav CS: BetaApps "appreciate the rapid rollback and updates". closing loop.

Avery Eng: PR link (hotfix): https://git.internal/redwood/infra/merge_requests/8264 — description: revert matcher change, add smoke tests for `quota_key` encoding, run ledger reconciler.

Maya SRE: adding monitoring dashboard panel for exemption-hit-rate and token-ledger-deltas.

IncidentBot: [RESOLVED] Incident cleared to watch. incident_id: INC-2026-0315-01
